definitions.explanation: The back part of the human foot below the ankle.
The raised part at the back of a shoe.

examples.japanese: {踵|かかと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。

notes:
{踵|かかと} refers to both the body part and the shoe part.

OFTEN IN HIRAGANA:
This word is very frequently written as かかと due to the kanji's complexity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {踵|かかと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high heels)
- {踵|かかと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (turn on one's heel)
- {踵|かかと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (raise one's heels, stand on tiptoe)

- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (sole of foot)
- ⟦つま{先|さき}→爪先：16422_tsumasaki⟧ (toe/tiptoe)
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧ (toes)
